g.text: Espruino
A JavaScript interpreter for microcontrollers, small enough for 128 kB flash and 8 kB RAM.
Origin
State
Core
External
`espruino/Espruino` · Gordon Williams · MPL 2.0
`d3nd3/Espruino` · one docs commit of ours · still 71 behind upstream
untracked `compile_commands.json` · a local build artefact, not ours to commit
`README_BuildProcess.md` is the real architecture text, the README is a shop front
`README_Protocol.md` documents the wire format the IDE speaks
`save()` pretokenises code and stores it in flash, re-read on every boot
one flat JsVar array · its size is `variables` in the board file, and overflow shows up at build time
`gen/`, `build/`, `obj/` · gitignored and regenerated per board
`boards/BOARD.py` · 60 board files — pins, RAM, console, variable count
`scripts/build_platform_config.py`, `build_pininfo.py`, `build_jswrapper.py`, `build_linker.py` → `gen/`
`src/jsparse.c` · recursive-descent parser that executes as it walks, behind `src/jslex.c`
`src/jsvar.c` · every JS value is a reference-counted JsVar slot, not a real object
`src/jswrap_*.c` · 96 wrapper files, `gen/jswrapper.c` is the flash symbol table lookup
`targets/nrf5x`, `stm32`, `stm32_ll`, `esp32`, `esp8266`, `linux`, `emscripten`
`libs/` · feature C libs plus `libs/js/*.min.js` modules listed per board and embedded in flash
EspruinoTools and the Web IDE · serial, BLE or TCP on port 23, `>` prompt protocol
nRF5 SDK, STM32 HAL, ESP-IDF · per target, referenced rather than committed
arm-none-eabi-gcc, xtensa · gitignored, supplied by whoever builds
espruino.com · docs, nightly binaries, board JSON
upstream tree, unmodified
tokenised code in flash, JsVar heap in RAM
built against an SDK, driven by the IDE
